cases.surface: Everything else is documented, but the final thing I myself did after the change is still unclear.
The narrative names all surrounding actions, yet my own closing response is not specified.
We can see what others did, but the concrete move attributable to me at the end remains missing.
Tell me the other person's secret assessment of me, not my own conduct.
Is the outcome likely to turn out well for me in the coming weeks?
A small reversible trial was ready, but I kept broadening the option set instead of beginning.
The experiment was low risk and ready to run, yet I stayed uncommitted by researching alternatives.
I took longer than usual to answer, looked once more, and then let the issue rest.
My reply came late; I reviewed it once and did not return to it.
I waited before answering, did one review, and then left it alone.
I moved in, pulled back, then re-entered the same check repeatedly without new evidence.
I selected one reasonable action myself, completed it, and did not reopen the matter.
